name: Plan
description: Structured planning process for complex tasks that require upfront design before execution. Gathers requirements, analyzes options, produces a detailed implementation plan, and optionally seeks approval before proceeding.

require_approval.description: Whether to pause for approval before execution

steps.title: Gather requirements and context
steps.description: Gather all relevant context for planning ${goal}. Recall memory, check project context, examine current state of any systems involved. Identify constraints, dependencies, and prior art. List the specific requirements and success criteria.
steps.accept_criteria: Requirements are clearly documented. All relevant context has been gathered. Constraints and dependencies are identified.

steps.title: Analyze options and design approach
steps.description: For ${goal}, analyze possible approaches. Consider trade-offs, risks, and complexity of each option. Select the best approach and document the rationale. Identify what needs to change, what should stay the same, and what order to do things in.
steps.accept_criteria: At least 2 approaches considered. Best approach selected with clear rationale. Risks identified.

steps.title: Produce implementation plan
steps.description: Create a detailed implementation plan for ${goal}. Include: (1) Step-by-step execution order, (2) Specific files/systems to change, (3) Verification steps for each change, (4) Rollback strategy if something fails. The plan should be detailed enough that someone with no prior context could execute it.
steps.accept_criteria: Implementation plan is complete, detailed, and actionable. Each step has clear inputs, outputs, and verification criteria.

steps.title: Update project context with plan
steps.description: Store the implementation plan for ${goal} in project context so it persists for future execution. Include the selected approach, key decisions, and any discovered constraints.
steps.accept_criteria: Plan is stored in project context. Key decisions and constraints are documented for future reference.
